scope: Calculations use only Pokemon/forms, learnable moves and abilities in the pinned Champions catalog. Lists outside this intersection are not imported. Catalog presence does not establish mechanics support.
ourImplementation: Only the existing singles Earthquake check is implemented; expanded conditional inputs and state-transition rules are design decisions or proposals.

engineReference.method: Recalculate each damage array with consumed/removed item or updated ranks; accumulate the engine arrays. Berry 2HKO enumerates 16 x 16 independent rolls, not a handwritten damage formula.

flingItemProbe.scope: All 166 items present in both installed Champions data and pinned Showdown Champions data; attacker Weavile, defender Snorlax. Table power is separate from species-specific item-removal/throw legality.

effects.expectedAfterHitEffect: target negative ranks cleared after damage

repeatProbe.sourceExpectation: Item consumed after first use; no reacquisition modeled.

limits: Mega-stone source table power does not override the species-specific onTakeItem restriction.
Returned state alone is not a full battle log; missing effects were also checked against engine Fling code, which only reads item-based power.

pokemonFormNames.method: Preserve existing Korean site labels; fill five missing forms using the following official Korean name/form references. Historical siteName and listing-match fields remain unchanged.

consoleObservations.context: During reset/autocomplete entry transitions before valid selection completed
consoleObservations.message: [warning] [calculate] TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'megaStone')
consoleObservations.impact: Recorded as a transition warning. No claim that all valid calculations fail; compared numeric outputs were captured after completed selections.

limits: 82 observations include input-boundary and unsuccessful-search observations; they are not 82 independent mechanic proofs.
Raw DOM captures can include CSS-hidden inputs; control presence was also checked through the UI and complete virtual lists.
Missing ability selector entries can be intentional filtering; damage-irrelevant entries are not treated as missing calculator functionality.
No game-screen measurement, exhaustive move/ability/item combination validation or source-code audit of the external calculator.
Generic manual power/multiplier changes are distinguished from native conditional-input support.
Tool transfer moves Thief/Covet and berry-stealing/consumption sequences were not independently verified; Magician/Pickpocket selector absence alone does not establish every transfer path.

catalogListingMethod.moves: Public https://smartnuo.com/api/move records; ID existence, not exhaustive UI selection or mechanic verification.
catalogListingMethod.pokemon: Public https://smartnuo.com/api/pokemon records with canonical and engine aliases; does not prove every separate form UI path.
catalogListingMethod.abilities: Complete virtual-scroll choices in the inspected damage and speed calculators.

faintedAllies.note: Product input limit; source Last Respects mechanic cap remains 100.

itemRemoval.behavior: Recalculate later damage after item consumption/removal.

postUseStatDrops.behavior: Use supplied initial final ranks, then apply successful-use rank drops to later attacks.

rankChanges.scope: Guaranteed rank increases, decreases and resets from the selected damaging move.
rankChanges.enabled: Apply guaranteed rank changes at each move's actual timing and recalculate affected later damage.
rankChanges.disabled: Keep the supplied initial final ranks unchanged.
rankChanges.clearSmog: Calculate the first hit with the target's supplied ranks, reset target ranks after a successful hit, then use the reset ranks for later uses.
rankChanges.probabilisticRankEffects: Excluded from automatic accumulation and probability aggregation; use the existing rank inputs to specify a state after such an effect has occurred.

hpDependentEffects.behavior: Update remaining HP per damage outcome after each hit and use that HP for subsequent damage and KO calculations.
hpDependentEffects.explicitActivationToggles: Preserve any conditions explicitly fixed through the agreed activation toggles.
hpDependentEffects.implementationAlgorithm: Not implemented; identical-state merging and damage-result reuse have been proposed.

screenAndTerrainRemoval.behavior: Apply each supported move's screen or terrain removal at its actual timing and recalculate affected later damage.

steelRoller.otherFieldModifiers: Apply the selected field modifiers normally.

singleUseResults.reflectionInput: Calculate incoming damage from the linked opponent build and move, then derive the reflected damage distribution.
singleUseResults.reflectionMissingInput: Prompt for a missing opponent move without requiring the defense-comparison checkbox.

abilityChangingEffects.scope: Abilities that change, exchange or copy abilities, including Mummy, Wandering Spirit and Trace.

disguise.behavior: When Disguise activates, absorb the first qualifying hit, apply the break HP loss, then calculate remaining hits and uses with broken Disguise.
disguise.breakHpLoss: One eighth of maximum HP under the source rounding rule.

airBalloon.behavior: Remove after the first attack hit that satisfies the balloon-breaking condition; recalculate later grounding and terrain eligibility.
airBalloon.groundImmunity: A Ground attack made ineffective by Air Balloon does not pop it.

berries.selector: One generic resist-berry option, labelled 반감열매.
berries.interpretation: Use the resist berry corresponding to the effective type of the selected attack, preserving normal activation rules.
berries.consumption: Apply to the first qualifying hit only, then consume and recalculate later hits and uses.
berries.results: Show berry-applied and post-consumption damage separately with a first-qualifying-hit note.
berries.berryEatingMoves: No separate stolen-berry eating-effect simulation for Bug Bite or Pluck beyond the supported resist-berry handling.

statusConditions.selection: One status per Pokemon, selected through toggles and maintained throughout repeated KO calculation.
statusConditions.scope: Own Pokemon status shared across opponents; each opponent status shared across its attack, defense and speed comparisons.
statusConditions.automaticAbilityDefault: Retain the ability-specific default status on selection; permit explicit user changes and clearing.
statusConditions.sharedValue: Status-dependent moves and abilities use the same selected status.
statusConditions.burn: Use engine physical-damage reduction and normal exceptions; do not halve the supplied Attack stat.
statusConditions.paralysis: Use engine final Speed reduction and normal exceptions, including moves that reference final Speed.

hpManipulationMoveExclusions.scope: Exclude these three moves from the calculator's move selection and calculations; retain raw catalog and historical audit data.

itemTransfer.behavior: Ordinary move base power and other normal damage modifiers apply; held items are not transferred.

fling.itemPower: Use Champions item metadata to fill engine power gaps.
fling.throwability: Validate item possession and item/species restrictions.

whiteHerb.when: Rank accumulation enabled; negative ranks after a successful move use.
whiteHerb.effect: Restore negative ranks to zero, then consume once.

normalGem.affectedHits: Every selected hit of that use.
normalGem.results: Show boosted first use and post-consumption damage separately.

hpOneSurvival.trigger: Full HP and a qualifying lethal hit.
hpOneSurvival.focusSash: Survive at 1 HP; consume only on actual activation.
hpOneSurvival.sturdy: Apply the ability survival rule without consuming an item; preserve normal bypass and OHKO-immunity rules.
hpOneSurvival.multiHit: Update HP and activation state after each hit; subsequent hits can KO.
hpOneSurvival.damageOutput: Keep the move damage range and rolls; show survival guidance and reflect actual survival in KO probabilities.

fieldConditions.scope: Per opponent; shared by its attack, defense and speed comparisons.

behavior: Show unusable for moves blocked by Gravity

trickRoom.speedStats: Do not modify final Speed values.
trickRoom.comparison: Lower final Speed acts first within equal move priority; equal Speed remains tied.
trickRoom.damageSpeedReferences: Use the unchanged final Speed values for Electro Ball and Gyro Ball.
trickRoom.implementationBoundary: Speed-comparison result processing; installed engine Field has no Trick Room flag.

inputLayout.gravity: Independent ON/OFF toggle in collapsed additional field conditions; default OFF. Layout decided; implementation pending.
inputLayout.trickRoom: Independent ON/OFF toggle, proposed default OFF.
inputLayout.coexistence: Terrain, Gravity and Trick Room may coexist.

fieldConditions.duration: Use selected static conditions; no remaining-turn input.

ironBall.moveSpeedReferences: Reflect actual final Speed change in speed-dependent damage.

excludedAirborneStateEffects.magnetRise: Do not add active-state input or simulation.
excludedAirborneStateEffects.smackDown: Retain ordinary move damage; do not model its grounding volatile.

ohkoMoveExclusions.scope: Exclude OHKO moves from calculation selection; preserve raw catalog and diagnostic results.

additionalSourceInspection.observation: Field area contains a Gravity option.
additionalSourceInspection.method: Static page inspection, not an interactive calculation test.

currentProductClassification.note: Current product inputs and processing are generated from champions-product-rules.mjs. Original comparison observations and catalogHashes remain the historical comparison evidence.
